commit.message:
feat(oembed): video previews (#288)

* perf(video): adaptive bandwidth-tiered prefetch and HLS buffer tuning

- Prefetch 5 upcoming videos (was 3) with dynamic preconnect to media.divine.video
- New hlsConfigBuilder.ts with tiered buffer configs (low/medium/high)
- VideoPlayer uses buildHlsConfig() with live bandwidthTier via useBandwidthTier()
- getPreloadAttribute() adapts video preload based on connection speed
- Consolidates duplicate bandwidthTracker subscription pattern (was useState+subscribe,
  now useBandwidthTier() hook consistent with VideoCard)
- bandwidthTracker still used for recordLoad in handleLoadedData

Builds on existing infrastructure: getOptimalVideoUrl (VideoCard quality selection),
bandwidthTracker (recording), useBandwidthTier (subscription)

* Add oEmbed discovery link to Cloudflare Pages function

- Add upsertLinkTag() helper function to inject link tags in HTML head
- Add isVideoPage() and extractVideoId() helper functions
- Update injectMetaTags() to inject oEmbed discovery link for video pages
- Link format: relay.divine.video/api/oembed?url={video_url}
- Update test to verify oEmbed link injection

* fix(288): href escaping in upsertLinkTag and remove dead autoplay params

Address PR #288 review feedback from mbradley:
- Escape href in upsertLinkTag() using escapeHtml(), matching upsertMetaTag pattern
- Remove ?autoplay=1&muted=1 from embed iframe src (not read by SPA)

commit.message:
fix(dm): make NIP-17 self-wrap a non-fatal best-effort step (#313)

createDmGiftWraps iterated [sender, ...recipients] in that order and
threw on the first failure. The self iteration ran first — so any
failure in the self-encrypt path (e.g. Keycast bunker rejecting
nip44_encrypt with target=self) aborted the loop before any recipient
wrap was even attempted. The recipient never received the message.

Mirror mobile's pattern at
mobile/packages/dm_repository/lib/src/nip17_message_service.dart:
recipient delivery first, then a separate try/catch for the self copy.
A self-wrap failure is logged and swallowed; the recipient already got
the message and the cross-device recovery copy is best-effort.

- Split createDmGiftWraps into createRecipientGiftWraps (throws on
  failure) and createSelfGiftWrap (returns null + warns on failure).
- Reorder useDmSend.mutationFn: publish recipients first, then attempt
  self-wrap inside try/catch around both creation and publish.
- Drop the back-compat createDmGiftWraps wrapper since the only caller
  was useDmSend itself.

Closes #310

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
feat(dm): healthcheck NIP-44 capability at signer attach (#314)

* feat(dm): healthcheck NIP-44 capability at signer attach

useDmCapability checked Boolean(signer?.nip44) — a type-presence test,
not a capability test. A NIP-46 bunker that exposes the nip44 surface
but rejects the underlying RPC produced sessions where DMs appeared
available, every fetch silently failed, every send may fail late.

Add a one-time round-trip probe at session attach so the system
fails-loud-at-the-boundary instead of fail-silent-deep-in-the-stack.

- New probeBunkerNip44(signer, pubkey) in lib/dm — encrypt-to-self +
  decrypt-from-self, returns true iff the round-trip plaintext matches.
- New useBunkerDecryptHealthcheck hook — useQuery with staleTime:
  Infinity and one retry on transient failure.
- useDmCapability gates canUseDirectMessages on the healthcheck and
  exposes isCheckingDmCapability for loading-state rendering.
- MessagesPage and ConversationPage render a neutral "Checking signer
  capability..." surface during the probe instead of the negative
  "DMs unavailable" copy.

Local-key signers (NSecSigner) pass instantly; bunker signers add ~1×
round-trip latency at first inbox load. Subsequent loads use the
cached result.

Closes #311

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(dm): key healthcheck cache by login.id so bunker re-pair busts stale false

Addresses @DSanich review on #314: with staleTime/gcTime: Infinity, a healthcheck
that probed false (e.g. Keycast policy rejecting nip44_decrypt) stayed cached
across a bunker disconnect+re-pair on the same pubkey. Once the upstream policy
is fixed and the moderator reconnects, React Query was handing back the stale
false and DMs stayed "unavailable" until a hard reload.

login.id from useNostrLogin() is a fresh UUID per addLogin() call. Including it
in the healthcheck queryKey means a fresh pairing produces a fresh cache entry,
naturally bypassing the stale result. JWT signers lack nip44 so the healthcheck
never runs for them; falling back to '' for missing logins is safe.

Adds a regression test that asserts the probe runs twice when login.id changes
for the same pubkey.

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
feat(reports): split child safety into three distinct report categories (#364)

* feat(reports): split child safety into three distinct report categories

Splits the single "Child safety concern" report reason into:
- Child Safety Violation (general catch-all)
- Child Sexual Abuse (actual CSAM)
- User Appears Under 16 (age concern)

Refs: divinevideo/divine-mobile#3489

* fix: add NIP-56/NIP-32 mapping helpers, normalize label casing

Address review feedback:
- Add toNip56ReportType and toNip32ReportLabel mapping helpers aligned
  with mobile's content_reporting_service.dart mappings.
- Use helpers in useReportContent instead of leaking raw enum values
  into protocol tags (fixes NS-sexual-content → NS-sexualContent, etc).
- Normalize new report labels to sentence case matching existing pattern.
- Add test coverage for every ContentFilterReason mapping.

* Pin Node 20 for Pages builds

commit.message:
fix(dm): surface bunker decrypt failures in moderator inbox (#312)

* fix(dm): surface bunker decrypt failures in moderator inbox

unwrapDmGiftWrap collapsed every failure path (signer/RPC error,
malformed seal, hash mismatch, recipient mismatch) into a null return;
fetchDmMessages dropped them without preserving any signal. A moderator
inbox where the bunker rejected nip44_decrypt rendered as "No other
messages yet" — identical to a genuinely empty inbox.

Replace null returns with a discriminated DmUnwrapResult, aggregate
outcomes in FetchDmMessagesResult, plumb through useDmMessages, and
expose useDmInboxStatus so MessagesPage can render an explicit
"inbox temporarily unavailable" state when every fetched wrap failed
to decrypt.

Closes #309

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(dm): apply PR review feedback

- useDirectMessages.ts: replace ?? cascade in setQueryData updater with
  explicit ternary. Same behavior, clearer intent.
- dm.test.ts: extract createDmTestWrap and createMockSigner helpers next
  to createTestSigner; refactor three failure-path tests.
- MessagesPage.test.tsx: import DmInboxStatus instead of redeclaring
  the inline union.
- dm.ts: add TODO(#321) above attestation/hash mismatch checks for the
  malformed sub-classification follow-up.
- useDirectMessages.test.ts: fix test seeds to use FetchDmMessagesResult
  shape; prior bare-array seeds were masked by the old defensive
  ?? cascade in updateDmMessageCaches.
- Add docs/brainstorm/ doc capturing review-response analysis and trace
  findings (referenced from #322).

Refs #312, #321, #322.

* chore(dm): drop brainstorm doc from PR

Per review feedback on #312: the design-rationale doc is a process
artifact, not a feature deliverable. AGENTS.md requires PRs to stay
tightly scoped.

Refs #312.

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
